metadata.environment: LLAM_* overrides removed; RELEASE_FAST, one P, lock-free normal queue
metadata.throughput: completed exact select exchanges per second; setup/warmup/teardown excluded
metadata.p99: nearest rank over every select entry-to-return observation; exact value/count histograms
metadata.ready: buffer fill precedes each ready select; throughput includes fill and result checks
metadata.park: sender waits for PARKED; every measured call exercises wait preparation and cleanup
metadata.limits: single-P closed-loop benchmark; no timing guarantee under arbitrary OS load
